from spicy_regs.etl_receipts import ReceiptContext, decode_exact_json, split_record, validate_receipt_row
from spicy_regs.scorecards.etl import POLICIES, SOURCE_NAMES, _witnesses
from spicy_regs.scorecards.registry import load_registry
from spicy_regs.scorecards.retained import RetainedScorecardBatch
from spicy_regs.scorecards.subject_shapes import map_source_row, restore_source_row

ROOT=Path.cwd();CORPUS=ROOT.parent.parent.parent
PLAN=ROOT/'docs/research/scorecards/work/integration/new_american_print_2008_plan_20261005.json'
assert sha256(PLAN.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='6573d71ddafe7d8a176e16a0f1123b5ff56fefd509f3437d54bf5c1c4b7501f6'
assert version('spicy-docs')=='0.61.0'
assert Path(spicy_docs.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to((ROOT/'.venv').resolve())
WHEEL=ROOT/'vendor/spicy_docs-0.61.0-py3-none-any.whl'
assert sha256(WHEEL.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='081cfb339b63d3ea6b396cea68f1ae3a2a5e339a10355325c64e07e295ae74ea'
installed=Path(spicy_docs.__file__).resolve().parent.parent;files=0
with ZipFile(WHEEL) as wheel:
 for name in wheel.namelist():
  if name.startswith('spicy_docs/') and not name.endswith('/'):
   assert (installed/name).read_bytes()==wheel.read(name),name;files+=1
plan=json.loads(PLAN.read_bytes());assert len(plan['entries'])==1;entries=plan['entries'];captures=[];retentions=[];scopes=[];start=time.perf_counter()
def retain(document,body,*,stage):
 assert sha256(body).hexdigest()==entries[0]['observations_sha256']
 retentions.append({'source_sha256':sha256(document.body).hexdigest(),'asset_sha256':sha256(body).hexdigest(),'stage':stage})
 return {'observation_id':str(uuid4())}
batch=RetainedScorecardBatch(CORPUS,entries,retain_observations=retain)
def capture(response,**kwargs):
 captures.append({'url':response.requested_url,'sha256':sha256(response.body).hexdigest(),'stage':kwargs.get('stage')})
 return {'capture_id':str(uuid4())}
context=ScorecardContext(batch,capture,max_requests=3)
for edition in batch.list_scorecards(context):
 entry=batch.entries[edition.scorecard_id];adapter=get_adapter(entry['adapter']);path=Path(adapter.__file__).resolve()
 assert path.is_relative_to((ROOT/'.venv').resolve()) and sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==entry['reader_sha256']
 for relative,pin in entry['shared_source_dependencies'].items():
  assert sha256((path.parents[2]/relative.removeprefix('src/spicy_docs/')).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==pin,relative
 result=batch.for_edition(edition).acquire_scorecard(edition,context);tables=result.tables;validate_scorecard_bundle(tables)
 assert set(tables)==set(SOURCE_NAMES)==set(POLICIES)-{'scorecard_member_links','scorecard_item_links'}
 for name,rows in tables.items():
  policy=POLICIES[name]
  for index,raw in enumerate(rows):
   mapped=map_source_row(name,raw);subject,receipt=split_record(policy,mapped,ReceiptContext('new-american-print-memory-check',f'{edition.scorecard_id}:{name}:{index}',policy.policy_version,_witnesses(raw)))
   validate_receipt_row(receipt,POLICIES);restored=restore_source_row(name,(subject or {})|decode_exact_json(receipt['processing_json']))
   assert restored==raw,(edition.scorecard_id,name,index)
 scopes.append({'publisher_id':edition.publisher_id,'scorecard_id':edition.scorecard_id,'counts':{name:len(rows) for name,rows in tables.items()},'complete_reference':'PASS','all_source_fields_final_consumer_policy_roundtrip':'PASS','reader_sha256':entry['reader_sha256']})
batch.complete();assert len(batch.checked)==1 and len(captures)==3 and len(retentions)==1
registry=load_registry();assert {r.publisher_id for r in registry}==set(ADAPTER_PUBLISHERS.values())
reg=next(r for r in registry if r.publisher_id=='new_american')
assert reg.adapter=='new_american' and reg.enabled is False and reg.historical_backfill is False and reg.evidence_policy=='hash_only' and reg.rights_status=='unreviewed'
